title: Warmth and Hope: Clothes Distribution Initiative
excerpt: Megh Foundation's clothes distribution drive supports dignity, comfort, and confidence for families living in vulnerable urban settlements.
coverImageAlt: Clothes distribution support for families in underserved communities
bodyMarkdown:
## Dignity through essentials

In underserved urban communities, access to clean and suitable clothing directly affects health, dignity, and participation in daily life. Megh Foundation's clothes distribution initiative addresses this immediate need with care and respect.

## How the initiative is delivered

- Need mapping with local community leaders
- Organized collection and sorting support
- Dignified, person-first distribution events
- Focus on children, women, and high-need households

## Human impact

For many families, receiving quality clothing reduces financial pressure and restores confidence. Children attend school with greater dignity, and caregivers can redirect scarce resources toward food, education, and healthcare.

## Why it matters

The initiative reflects a simple principle: meaningful development begins by meeting urgent needs while preserving human dignity.
